title: Chintamani Library v2.5.0 — Premium Claymorphism Design & Cloud Selfie Upload Fix
releaseNotes: REDESIGN: Premium Claymorphism More Screen — deep 3D card sections, gold glow avatar, tactile animated press states
FIX: Selfie upload 'Failed due to low memory' error completely resolved — images now stream to Cloudinary cloud storage via multipart upload instead of base64 JSON
FIX: Photos, Aadhaar & payment screenshots now stored permanently in Cloudinary (not ephemeral server disk)
FIX: Registration portal JSON body size limit increased to handle all portal data
IMPROVEMENT: Branch data isolation enforced at backend — Mehdawal (65 seats) & Khalilabad (72 seats) fully separated
